Applies request-scoped external findings before output rendering

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	xberg "github.com/xberg-io/xberg/packages/go"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	input := xberg.ExtractInput{
		Kind:     ptr(xberg.ExtractInputKindBytes),
		Bytes:    []byte{116, 111, 107, 101, 110, 45, 55, 52, 50, 57, 32, 101, 109, 97, 105, 108, 101, 100, 32, 97, 108, 105, 99, 101, 64, 101, 120, 97, 109, 112, 108, 101, 46, 99, 111, 109, 46},
		MimeType: ptr(`text/plain`),
		Filename: ptr(`external-findings.txt`),
	}
	config := xberg.ExtractionConfig{}
	offset_encodingVal := `unicode_code_points`
	result, err := xberg.ExtractWithExternalRedaction(input, config, `[{"Type":"inspection_token","Text":"token-7429","Score":0.99,"Attributes":{"provider":"aws"}}]`, &offset_encodingVal, 8)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Results[0].Content)
}
```
